title: Cheesy Butternut Squash and Swiss Chard Lasagne
changes_from_base: A small meat-free lasagne for 4: microwaved butternut squash and Swiss chard with a sage cheese sauce instead of ragù and béchamel.
summary: A small lasagne for 4 with butternut squash, Swiss chard and a sage cheese sauce, ready in about 75 min.

ingredients.item: butternut squash, peeled and in 1 cm dice
Swiss chard, stems removed, leaves in 2.5 cm pieces

steps.title: Cheese sauce
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Whisk the cottage cheese, Parmesan, cream, sage, cornflour and pepper in a bowl. The cheeses bring enough salt, so none is added.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Mix the squash, chard, oil, garlic, lemon zest and nutmeg in the bowl, cover and microwave about 7 min until the chard wilts and the squash is just tender. Drain in the colander for 5 min; this gets rid of the water that would otherwise thin the sauce.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Grease the dish, spread in 240 ml cheese sauce and lay 2 sheets on top. Add half the vegetables and half the remaining sauce, then 2 more sheets, the rest of the vegetables and about 120 ml sauce. Top with the last 2 sheets, the remaining sauce and the mozzarella.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover tightly with greased foil and bake about 30 min until bubbling at the edges. Uncover and bake 10-15 min until spotty brown. Rest 15 min before serving.

tips: Dice the squash small so it cooks evenly.
storage: Cool, cover and refrigerate within 2 hours for up to 3 days, or freeze portions for up to 2 months. Reheat covered in a 180 °C oven until piping hot (74 °C) in the centre.
